## 7. The pool alone (X = 1, m = 0): F/(R n) = sum_z |Q(z)|^2/(R sum|a_P|^2), ppqalone.py

Null expectation 1 (up to the coprimality correction of a few per mille for P0 >~ 100).  gsimple/gcanon: a_P = conj g~(P) with additive character e(x/p) resp. e(-b x/p);
gsimple_c/gcanon_c: the non-conjugated Gauss sums; ang1/ang-1: angular characters (P/|P|)^{+-1}.  SE = row-sampling error (about the same for every column).
